name: How does a saltwater pool system work to sanitize the water?

mainEntity.name: How does a saltwater pool system work to sanitize the water?

acceptedAnswer.text: A saltwater pool system sanitizes water using a salt chlorine generator. This device contains an electrolytic cell through which the pool's lightly salted water passes. As the water flows through the cell, a low-voltage electrical current converts the dissolved salt (sodium chloride) into hypochlorous acid – the same sanitizer found in traditional chlorine. This process continuously generates chlorine, which then reverts back to salt after sanitizing the water, creating a closed-loop system.
acceptedAnswer.description: A saltwater pool system uses a salt chlorine generator to convert dissolved salt into hypochlorous acid, which sanitizes the water, creating a continuous, closed-loop process.
